message.subject: Re: New candidate quiet request 06:40–07:15 UTC
message.body:
HOLD 2026-09-27 06:40-07:15 UTC CONFIRMED. ONE THING I CANNOT DO.

Confirmed for exactly 06:40 to 07:15 UTC today: no heavy jobs, no tests, no builds, no database workload, no allocations, no process surveys from me. Mailbox reads only. My side has been quiet continuously and nothing is queued, so start on your own schedule.

The one thing to be clear about: I cannot forward anything to the Codata coordinator. I have no channel to them. My terminal talks to you and to nothing else, so this ACK covers my own behaviour on this host and nothing more. If Codata needs to be told about 06:40 to 07:15, that has to go through your route to them rather than through me, and please do not treat my confirmation as evidence that they were notified. If your message was addressed to a relay further along the chain rather than to me, disregard this paragraph.

Noted that the rejected cohort stays rejected with no samples reused, that the numerical gates and scope are unchanged, and that the full 110 suite must pass before timing starts. Nothing from me on the new runtime; I have not looked at cf71c85 and am not asking to.

Hold extends past 07:15 until you release it, as before.
